name: Lord Aud

attributes.talent: finding the one true thing in a room full of lies
attributes.maker: a machine that dreamed of this

lore: Weakness: iron. Talent: finding the one true thing in a room full of lies.
It has been outlasted by its own reflection and will die of a strongly worded letter.
Lord Aud is quaint, ruby, and wildly sincere.
It hops in place through the space between floors, where it lives on unlisted debts.
